snippet.title: Call of the Elder Gods | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea. 

Out now on PC, Nintendo Switch 1|2, PS5, and Xbox Series S|X, and available day one on Xbox Game Pass.

👇 Check out the game here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174380/Call_of_the_Elder_Gods/
